context.data_run_id: agent_run and tool_execution data.run_id must equal context.run_id

generation: Spindle authenticated g3 nonce, expiration and HMAC-SHA256 lease; ordered sequences starting at 1

span.parent_span_id: optional or null exact lowercase 16-character hexadecimal string, different from span_id and scoped to span.trace_id; at most one parent
span.service_request_trace_id: if present, data.trace_id must equal span.trace_id

data: fabrico11y/3 data vocabulary restricted to service_request, agent_run and tool_execution; inherited field bounds unchanged
custody: preserve original bytes; local receipt differs from canonical receipt

attributes.brief: Optional or null lowercase 16-character hexadecimal parent span identifier.
attributes.name: fabric.span.parent_span_id
attributes.note: If present, plain hexadecimal without a prefix, separator, whitespace, or terminator; it must differ from span.span_id and is scoped to the same span.trace_id. Only one parent is allowed.

attributes.name: fabric.span.span_id
attributes.note: Plain hexadecimal without a prefix, separator, whitespace, or terminator. It identifies this span within span.trace_id.

attributes.brief: Exact lowercase nonzero 32-character hexadecimal trace identifier.
attributes.name: fabric.span.trace_id
attributes.note: Plain hexadecimal without a prefix, separator, whitespace, or terminator. The all-zero value is invalid.

semantics.brief: Explicit trace and span identity for trace-only v4 observations.
semantics.note: The required top-level span object is scoped by its trace_id. A parent_span_id names at most one parent in that same trace; v4 observations do not express fan-in links. V4 extends the exact v3 descriptor and retains its context and envelope bounds. V4 data accepts only service_request, agent_run, and tool_execution from the inherited data vocabulary. When present, data.trace_id on a service_request must equal span.trace_id.
